privileged_info_for_vlm: The database contains 11 distinct nationalities (American, Australian, British, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Spanish). There are 10 unique nationality-level friendship edges. All edges in this specific dataset have a FriendshipCount of 1, meaning there is no single 'strongest' connection; any edge with count 1 is technically tied for strongest. The British nationality has a ProfileCount of 3.
